baselineModification: Only the identical opt-in EngineMoonMeasurementTests.swift probe was added to the baseline.
limits: Timings and peak RSS are single-process, single-host observations under the release test harness; no performance or storage ceiling is inferred.
All record boundaries are checked, but integrated source states and event inputs are sampled. Full-range absolute velocity and event-time accuracy remain unqualified.
Public Moon APIs still use C pending issue #96. Issue #184 remains open for link 4 qualification and closure work.

maintenanceVerification.change: The DE441 Swift output moved byte-for-byte into Generated/DE441 so the legacy Moon generator owns only its direct Generated/*.swift outputs. Runtime source contents and qualified payload are unchanged from nativeMeasurementsCommit.
maintenanceVerification.sourceHashScope: Hashes identify current generation tooling and runtime sources; timing, RSS and object-size observations were recorded at nativeMeasurementsCommit.

storage.scope: Object and literal sizes precede application linking, stripping and distribution compression; they are not download-size claims.

validation.fixtureDomain: 1365 raw source comparisons, of which 1360 are inside accepted TT and exercise integrated state and ecliptic inputs; padded source records extend beyond accepted TT.
validation.python: 24 tests pass on Python 3.11 and 3.14, including both Moon generators through check/regeneration/fresh-output lifecycles without changing either payload; all seven CI-generated-table checks pass.
validation.tolerances: Existing angular, distance, central state, event-input and derivative-consistency tolerances are retained. Raw sampled rates use the previously qualified representation bound, not a new physical velocity requirement.
